title: Antigravity Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for Antigravity plugin manifest files (plugin.json). NOTE: the canonical identifier below is published in the Antigravity documentation as a `$schema` value and an editor-autocomplete aid, but the URL itself does NOT resolve — https://antigravity.google/schemas/v1/plugin.json returns HTTP 404. This file is transcribed verbatim from the "Full JSON Schema" block at https://antigravity.google/docs/plugins/ (fetched 2026-09-28) because there is nothing to fetch it from.

name.description: The unique, machine-readable name of the plugin. Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

description.description: A brief human-readable description of the plugin's purpose and capabilities.
